templates.name: en-landing
templates.description: TIER1 T1. Škoda Storyboard English landing/home page (WordPress front page). Hero/featured promo grid + thematic teaser rails (Latest Stories, Social media, Models, eMobility, Lifestyle, Škoda World, Series, Latest News). Dynamic systems (media-cart add hooks, promo banners, newsletter, social feed, load-more) are omitted or rendered as static stubs. DONE + live; polish only.

templates.name: en-stories
templates.description: TIER1 T2 (flattened slice). Škoda Storyboard English story articles imported as lightweight pages (hero image + title + intro/body) under /en/stories/<slug>, each carrying metadata (title, description, image, publisheddate ISO, category, template=story) so a published query-index auto-populates the Latest Stories block. Full-fidelity story shell (gallery/embed/media-box, two-column) is T2 build.

templates.name: story-detail
templates.description: TIER1 T2. Full-fidelity story detail — Shell A two-column (66.6/33.3): hero + rich text + in-body gallery-lightbox + embeds (YouTube) + foot press-kit-media (Media Box); secondary column tags + newsletter + social-share; related story-rail. Meta template=story with category/tags/model. Spec: story-detail.md.

templates.name: storyboard-model
templates.description: TIER1 T3. Storyboard model page (skoda_model CPT). Hero overlay carousel + icon section-nav + Model Description rich text + key-facts + 5 tag-driven story-rail rails (News/Press Kits/Stories/Images/Videos filtered by the model tag). Meta template=skoda_model, model+tags=<slug>. Spec: template-model-page.md.

templates.name: series-directory
templates.description: TIER1 T4. Series directory — Shell B template-tiles: hero overlay + cards-overlay grid of series cards. series block variant=directory. Spec: series.md.

templates.name: series-hub
templates.description: TIER1 T5. Series hub (single-skoda_series). Hero overlay + curated cards-overlay story grid (FIXED count, no load-more). series block variant=hub. Meta template=skoda_series. Spec: series.md.

templates.name: media-room-home
templates.description: TIER1 T6. Media Room home. Featured promo + News feed (stories template=press_release, load-more) + Models (dark) + Latest Stories + Images + Videos + Press Kits rails (story-rail by template). footer-mediaroom. Meta template=page. Spec: template-home.md.

templates.name: category-listing
templates.description: TIER1 T7. Category listing (category archive). Hero + card-teaser grid (stories filtered category=<slug>) + load-more. No facets. Meta template=page. Spec: template-category-archive.md.

templates.name: tag-model-listing
templates.description: TIER1 T8. Tag/model listing. CTA hero (Discover/Configure/Images/Videos) + filtered card-teaser grid (tags=<slug>) + load-more. Meta template=page. Spec: template-category-archive.md.

templates.name: faceted-listing-news
templates.description: TIER2 T9. Faceted listing (News) — Shell C listing engine: facet pill bar + card-teaser grid + load-more (6/page) + newest/oldest sort. template=press_release, columns=3. Spec: faceted-listing.md.

templates.name: images-listing
templates.description: TIER2 T10. Images listing — listing engine columns=4 + gallery-lightbox + media-cart (add-to-cart, dual-rendition download). template=image. Spec: faceted-listing.md + gallery-lightbox.md + media-cart.md.

templates.name: videos-listing
templates.description: TIER2 T11. Videos listing — listing engine + embeds (Vimeo thumb/embed) + media-cart (MP4 download). template=video, columns=3. Spec: faceted-listing.md + embeds.md + media-cart.md.

templates.name: press-kit-hub
templates.description: TIER2 T12. Press-kit hub — Shell B template-tiles: hero + chapter-nav + cards-overlay chapter tiles + downloads (whole-kit ZIP) + faq-accordion. Meta template=press_kit, tags=<model>. Spec: press-kit-template.md.

templates.name: press-kit-chapter
templates.description: TIER2 T13. Press-kit chapter — Shell A two-column (no top hero): chapter-nav + article body + gallery-lightbox + press-kit-media (large Media Box); secondary downloads + tags. Meta template=page. Spec: press-kit-template.md.

templates.name: press-kit-resource
templates.description: TIER2 T14. Press-kit resource (infographics) — press-kit-variant: preview→PDF/JPG dual-format grid. Meta template=page. Spec: press-kit-variant.md.

templates.name: press-release-detail
templates.description: TIER2 T15. Press release detail — Shell A two-column, MR side, NO top hero: text title + lead teaser + bullets + rich text; secondary downloads + tags + newsletter; embeds (Buzzsprout AI-audio) + press-kit-media + full-bleed dark related band. Meta template=press_release, category=press-releases. Spec: template-press-release.md.
